policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: A raised hand with fingers maintaining a nonzero grasp opening after closure and lift is evidence of holding, even if object detections still report the old container center.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: A raised hand with fingers maintaining partial closure after grasp and lift is evidence of holding, even if object detections still report the old container center, provided no subsequent release is observed.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: When put-down execution shows release and the hand is empty, choose A on the first remaining target; do not select the previously picked container again merely because it is still visible.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: When execution shows the fingers opening fully followed by hand retreat with the fingers remaining fully open, treat the release as complete and the hand as empty, even if an object detection still describes a container as lifted. This release evidence takes priority over conflicting object detections and the held-container fallback. With remaining_targets nonempty, choose A on the container corresponding to its first point; do not select the previously picked container again merely because it is still visible.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For ambiguous or otherwise uncovered situations, choose B if the observations indicate a held container; otherwise choose A on the visible container nearest the first remaining point.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For ambiguous or otherwise uncovered situations with remaining_targets nonempty, choose B if the observations indicate a held container and no subsequent release is observed; a lifted-container report alone cannot establish holding in the presence of an observed release. Otherwise choose A on the visible container nearest the first remaining point.
